In our sample of six absorbers we detect molecular gas-rich galaxies in five absorber fields although we did not target high-metallicity ( > 50 per cent solar) systems for which previous studies reported the highest detection rate.

Our detection rate of > 80 per cent is higher than that reported in previous studies (Kanekar et al. 2018; Kanekar et al. 2020) suggesting that the H 2 -bearing gas absorbers trace CO molecular gas-rich galaxies.
